concerns.text: FR-001 (Download from NIST/Materials Project) and US-1 Scenario 1 are not covered. Task T013 is marked [ ] (unimplemented) and lacks a specific URL or API endpoint in its description, relying on a generic 'NIST/Materials Project' reference. The spec requires explicit downloading logic which is absent from the task definition.

FR-002 (SMILES to Graph conversion) and US-1 Scenario 3 (filtering non-polyesters) are not covered. Task T015 is marked [ ] (unimplemented). While T015b/c/d handle missing data, the core conversion and polyester filtering logic described in FR-002 and US-1 Scenario 3 is missing from the task list.

SC-004 (Power analysis on filtered dataset) is not covered. Task T017 is marked [ ] (unimplemented). The task depends on T016b (processed dataset) which is also unimplemented, creating a gap where the power analysis logic and trigger file generation are not defined.
FR-002/Plan (Subsampling for n > 150) is not covered. Task T018 is marked [ ] (unimplemented). The logic for stratified sampling and saving `final_dataset.csv` is missing.

FR-003 (Lightweight GNN architecture) is not covered. Task T024 is marked [ ] (unimplemented). The task description lacks the specific architectural constraints (≤3 layers, dim ≤128) and CPU-only requirement defined in FR-003.

FR-004 (Data augmentation) is not covered. Task T025 is marked [ ] (unimplemented). The task description mentions 'functional-group-preserving edge dropout' but lacks the specific algorithm details (non-ester bonds only, dropout rate 0.2) and the output artifact `final_dataset.csv` generation logic.

FR-003 (Training loop) is not covered. Task T028 is marked [ ] (unimplemented). The task lacks the specific k-fold cross-validation logic, seed pinning, and convergence check (loss within 5% over last 5 epochs) required by FR-003 and US-2 Scenario 1.

FR-005 (Integrated Gradients) is not covered. Task T029 is marked [ ] (unimplemented). The task description is too brief and does not specify the calculation of feature importance scores or the output format.

SC-005 (Feature attribution validity) is not covered. Task T030 is marked [ ] (unimplemented). The task lacks the specific logic for comparing ester bond attribution against a null distribution and the generation of `ester_attribution_check.json`.

FR-006 (Permutation test) is not covered. Task T037 is marked [ ] (unimplemented). The task description mentions 'shuffling input motifs' but lacks the specific statistic definition (mean macro-F1 drop), the number of permutations (1000), and the output schema for `permutation_test_results.json`.
FR-007 (Motif reporting) is not covered. Task T039 is marked [ ] (unimplemented). The task lacks the logic for aggregating feature importances and identifying the top 3-5 structural motifs.

FR-007 (Final report generation) is not covered. Task T040 is marked [ ] (unimplemented). The task lacks the specific content requirements for the final report (p-values, motif list, confidence flags).
Task T013 contains duplicate 'FAILED: unspecified' comments which are stale artifacts from a previous review cycle and should be removed to avoid confusion.
Task T025 contains a 'Plan Correction' note that references a 'Plan Correction' which is not a standard task tag. This should be clarified or removed to ensure the task description is self-contained.
